verses.1: When God created the heavens and the earth, he spoke.
verses.2: The Earth may be a barren planet, dominated by a real body of water. It may be a wasteland, a wasteland, a wasteland, a wasteland, a wasteland, a wasteland, a wasteland, a wasteland, a wasteland, a wasteland, a wasteland, a wasteland.
verses.3: The Lord said, "There is real light, " and there was real light.
verses.4: God saw the light and it was good, and God separated the light from the darkness.
verses.5: And God called the light Day, and the darkness he called Noon. And there was evening, and there was night, the first day.
verses.6: The Lord said that there would be a space between the waters that would separate the waters on both sides.
verses.7: And God created the firmament, and separated the waters that were under the firmament from the waters that were above the firmament, as God said.
verses.8: And God called it "sky. " And there was evening and there was morning - the second day.
verses.9: The Lord said that the waters under the earth would merge into one place and the rock wall would appear, and the Lord said that this would happen.
verses.10: God called the rock the wall, and the water that gathered together he called the sea, and God saw that it was good.
verses.11: God says that the earth produces vegetation, seed-bearing trees, and plants that produce quality seeds according to their kind on the earth. And God says so.
verses.12: The earth produces plants, plants with seeds of their own kind, and plants with the ability to produce seeds of their own kind, and God says it's good.
verses.13: And there was evening and there was day, the third day.
verses.14: God said that there should be lights at the center of the sun to separate the sun from the moon and to mark seasons, days, and years.
verses.15: There may have been a light in the sky to illuminate the world, perhaps as God thought.
verses.16: Then God made two great lights, the greater light to rule the sun and the lesser light to rule the sun and the stars.
verses.17: God sent them to shine in the skies above the earth to give it light.
verses.18: and to rule over the sun and over the moon, and to divide the sun from the moon; and God saw that it was good.
verses.19: Thursday is the west and Thursday is the east.
verses.20: God said that the waters would be full of living creatures and that birds would fly over the face of the sky.
verses.21: And God created great rivers and moving creatures whose waters gave rise to their species, and He also created species of birds with their eggs. And God saw that this was very good.
verses.22: God blessed them and said to them, "Be fruitful and multiply; fill the waters under the sea, and let birds multiply on the earth".
verses.23: The fifth day is the west and the fifth day is the east.
verses.24: God said that the earth would produce all living things, animals of every kind, reptiles of every kind, and amphibians of every kind. And it happened just as God had said.
verses.25: God created animals and plants according to their species, animals and plants according to their species, and all the land animals according to their species, and God saw fit to do so.
verses.26: Then God said, "Let us make men in our image, after our likeness; and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the air, over the livestock, over the whole earth, and over every moving thing that creeps on the earth".
verses.27: So God created man in his own image, in the image of God he created him. Man and woman he created them.
verses.28: Then God sent the goats and told them to "Be fruitful and multiply and have dominion over the earth; subdue the fish of the sea and the birds of the air and all living things that move along the earth".
verses.29: Then God said, "See, I have given you every tree on earth that produces seeds of grain and every tree that bears fruit - to be your food.
verses.30: To every beast of the earth and to every plant of the earth, to every bird of the air and to everything moving on the earth - I give them for food, just as I think is good".
verses.31: Then God looked at everything he had made and saw that it was very good. And it was evening - the sixth day.
